# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not open a public issue** for a security problem. Use GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing-information-about-vulnerabilities/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability)
on this repository.

## Threat model in brief

This project exposes a VoiceStudio backend through a random Cloudflare
quick-tunnel URL. Access requires **both** the tunnel hostname and the API key
generated by notebook box 2. See [docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md) for the
full model, key handling, and hardening steps.

## What is a credential here

* The random `*.trycloudflare.com` hostname
* The 43-character API key (stored at `~/.config/VoiceStudio/remote-key.txt`
  and `/content/drive/omnivoice/api_key.txt`)

Neither may ever be committed. CI fails the build if a live-looking tunnel
hostname is present.
